indicator_rule: Indicators meet Gentry's test. Lists stay flat (Grabo). Departure status is read from free text, so every change goes to a person for review before it is counted.
emerging_concerns: A country that gets a departure order, a level-4 advisory or a new EASA bulletin without being in any Watchfloor zone goes to Watchfloor's review queue.

indicators.text: The US orders or authorizes the departure of embassy staff, or suspends embassy operations
indicators.series: departure status read from State's advisory text
indicators.rule: post posture changes from normal (or rises on the ladder)

indicators.text: A US travel advisory is raised to level 4
EASA issues a new conflict-zone bulletin or strengthens one
indicators.rule: a new active bulletin, or a revision that moves a recommendation from caution to do not operate

indicators.text: Military, launch or mine warnings to mariners in the region
indicators.rule: a warning in category military, launch or mines within the area

indicators.text: A health, disaster or administrative cause is named for the change
indicators.rule: the departure sentence names a health, natural-disaster or administrative reason

indicators.text: The change comes from Cordon's reading, not the source
indicators.series: source health and the review queue
indicators.rule: the source failed, or a person found the phrase match wrong

warning_problems.title: A diplomatic or aviation drawdown in a country (any country)

watch_condition.current: set per country from CD-IND-1 to CD-IND-3

warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice when a post's status or a bulletin changes; stay silent while it holds.
warning_problems.deactivation: Back to normal when the post returns to normal operations and no bulletin is active.

hypotheses.statement: Security is deteriorating: conflict, attack or unrest is expected
Political signalling or a dispute (reciprocity, sanctions, a downgrade of relations)
A non-security cause: health, natural disaster or administration
Artefact: a source failure or a wrong phrase match
